_doc: Explicit event-type -> shock assumptions for the Strategic Stress Lab. All shocks are specified AT IMPACT SCORE 10 and scaled linearly by (impact/10)^severity_exponent. SIMPLIFIED PROTOTYPE METHODOLOGY - not a production or regulatory (CCAR/EBA) model. Equity shocks are fractional price moves; rates are parallel yield shifts in bp; spreads are bp widening by rating bucket; PD multipliers scale base default probability; vol_shock is additive implied-vol points.

GEOPOLITICAL.label: Geopolitical shock
GEOPOLITICAL.description: Risk-off repricing: equities sell off (energy and defence cushion), sovereign yields fall on flight-to-quality while credit spreads widen, borrower defaults rise in cyclical sectors and implied volatility spikes.

MACROECONOMIC.label: Macroeconomic slowdown
MACROECONOMIC.description: Growth scare: cyclical equities derate, yields drift lower, spreads widen modestly and loan delinquencies increase.

INTEREST_RATE.label: Interest-rate shock (+200bp)
INTEREST_RATE.description: Parallel upward rate shift: duration-based bond losses, floating-rate borrowers face debt-service stress, long-duration equities and rate-sensitive sectors derate, payer swaps gain.

REGULATORY.label: Regulatory action
REGULATORY.description: Targeted valuation shock for named companies and their sector peers; limited broad-market and credit contagion.

CREDIT_EVENT.label: Credit event / contagion
CREDIT_EVENT.description: Credit-spread blow-out and default wave: loans and bonds take the primary hit, bank equities sell off, CDS protection gains value.

MERGER_ACQUISITION.label: Merger / acquisition
MERGER_ACQUISITION.description: Event-driven repricing of named companies (target premium / acquirer discount); negligible market-wide effect.

EARNINGS.label: Earnings surprise
EARNINGS.description: Company-specific price reaction to earnings/guidance surprises; sector spill-over is small.

PRODUCT_LAUNCH.label: Product launch / innovation
PRODUCT_LAUNCH.description: Small company-specific price reaction; no credit or rates transmission.

COMMODITY_ENERGY.label: Commodity / energy price shock
COMMODITY_ENERGY.description: Energy-price spike: producers gain, energy-intensive and consumer sectors lose; inflation pushes yields up and widens HY spreads.

CYBER_OPERATIONAL.label: Cyber / operational disruption
CYBER_OPERATIONAL.description: Targeted loss for named firms and technology/financial peers; limited credit contagion.

NATURAL_DISASTER.label: Natural disaster / health shock
NATURAL_DISASTER.description: Demand and supply disruption: travel, industrial and real-estate exposures hit hardest; health care cushions; yields fall.

OTHER.label: Other / unclassified
OTHER.description: No explicit shock assumptions: only named entities receive a small move.
